source_cause: The collar outer upper corner sits about 13mm above the mantle. Oversized proximal sleeve rings and a linearly sloped mantle cut through the shoulders. Flat waistcoat top side termination did not form a fitted armhole. Concealed blouse hip radii exceeded the coat inner surface.
repair: Tuck concealed collar outer corners beneath the local mantle with a tapered corner height; retain the centre ivory neckline and lacing.
Taper concealed sleeve heads and underlying shoulder-root volume while preserving shoulder/elbow/wrist coordinates and existing arm weights.
Change mantle front/back shoulder turnover to gradual powers and add a local rear clearance contour. Reduce X extent slightly rather than inflating the entire garment.
Shape a curved waistcoat arm opening and resample its radii at the lowered height so it follows the shirt surface.
Taper concealed hip blouse under the belt and coat tails while leaving the visible ivory front apron intact.
numeric_check_limitations: Triangle crossing checks ignore coplanar contacts and are not a minimum-distance proof. The Idle simulation uses source-derived linear shoulder/elbow skin matrices and relative motion extrema; actual Blender motion/render and export verification remain mandatory.
